<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="512" height="512" viewBox="0 0 512 512">
  <defs>
    <filter id="texture">
      <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.05" numOctaves="3" result="noise"/>
      <feDiffuseLighting in="noise" lighting-color="#8B4513" surfaceScale="2">
        <feDistantLight azimuth="45" elevation="60"/>
      </feDiffuseLighting>
      <feComposite in2="SourceGraphic" operator="in"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <g id="tank-body" transform="translate(256, 256)">
    <!-- Tracks -->
    <g id="tracks">
      <rect x="-160" y="-140" width="60" height="280" rx="15" fill="#5D4037"/>
      <rect x="100" y="-140" width="60" height="280" rx="15" fill="#5D4037"/>
      <g fill="#A1887F" stroke="#3E2723" stroke-width="4">
        <path d="M-130 -120 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>
        <path d="M-130 -60 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>
        <path d="M-130 0 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>
        <path d="M-130 60 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>
        <path d="M130 -120 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>
        <path d="M130 -60 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>
        <path d="M130 0 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>
        <path d="M130 60 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Chassis Body -->
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="110" ry="140" fill="#8B4513" filter="url(#texture)"/>
    <path d="M-90 -50 C-120 -20, -120 20, -90 50 M90 -50 C120 -20, 120 20, 90 50" fill="none" stroke="#6D4C41" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- Toilet Paper Rolls -->
    <rect x="-140" y="-40" width="20" height="80" rx="5" fill="#FFF8E1" stroke="#D7CCC8" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="120" y="-40" width="20" height="80" rx="5" fill="#FFF8E1" stroke="#D7CCC8" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- Rear Flap -->
    <rect x="-30" y="110" width="60" height="30" rx="5" fill="#795548"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="125" r="8" fill="#5D4037" stroke="#3E2723" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M-5 120 l10 10 M-5 130 l10 -10" stroke="#EF5350" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- Turret -->
    <g id="turret">
      <path d="M-40 20 Q-50 -40 0 -60 Q50 -40 40 20 Z" fill="#795548"/>
      <!-- Eyes -->
      <circle cx="-15" cy="-20" r="12" fill="white"/>
      <circle cx="-15" cy="-20" r="4" fill="black"/>
      <circle cx="20" cy="-35" r="12" fill="white"/>
      <circle cx="20" cy="-35" r="4" fill="black"/>
      <!-- Tears -->
      <path d="M25 -25 Q30 -10 25 0" stroke="#81D4FA" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
      <!-- Corn Antenna -->
      <path d="M0 -60 L0 -80" stroke="#8D6E63" stroke-width="4"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="-85" r="8" fill="#FDD835"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Main Cannon -->
    <path d="M-10 -50 Q-20 -150 0 -180" fill="none" stroke="#5D4037" stroke-width="20" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Duck -->
    <g transform="translate(0, -180) rotate(-20)">
      <path d="M-15 -10 h30 v15 q0 10 -10 10 q-10 0 -10 -10 z" fill="#FFEB3B"/>
      <path d="M-15 0 q-10 0 -10 -5" fill="none" stroke="#FFEB3B" stroke-width="5"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Exhaust -->
    <circle cx="-60" cy="100" r="10" fill="#3E2723"/>
    <circle cx="-65" cy="115" r="6" fill="#B3E5FC" opacity="0.6"/>
    <circle cx="-75" cy="125" r="4" fill="#B3E5FC" opacity="0.4"/>
  </g>
</svg>

<svg width="440" height="410" viewBox="0 0 440 410" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <filter id="handDrawnStrong" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.04" numOctaves="4" result="turb" />
      <feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" in2="turb" scale="8" xChannelSelector="R" yChannelSelector="G" />
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- 左履带 -->
  <rect x="90" y="100" width="60" height="200" rx="15" fill="#2C3E50" stroke="#26334A" stroke-width="12" filter="url(#handDrawnStrong)" />
  <rect x="93" y="103" width="60" height="200" rx="15" fill="none" stroke="#2C3E50" stroke-width="9" opacity="0.8" filter="url(#handDrawnStrong)" />

  <!-- 右履带 -->
  <rect x="290" y="100" width="60" height="200" rx="15" fill="#2C3E50" stroke="#26334A" stroke-width="12" filter="url(#handDrawnStrong)" />
  <rect x="293" y="103" width="60" height="200" rx="15" fill="none" stroke="#2C3E50" stroke-width="9" opacity="0.8" filter="url(#handDrawnStrong)" />

  <!-- 坦克底盘 -->
  <rect x="130" y="120" width="180" height="160" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#26334A" stroke-width="13" filter="url(#handDrawnStrong)" />
  <rect x="134" y="124" width="180" height="160" rx="20" fill="none" stroke="#2C3E50" stroke-width="9" opacity="0.8" filter="url(#handDrawnStrong)" />

  <!-- 中间红色核心 -->
  <circle cx="220" cy="200" r="35" fill="#FF3030" stroke="#26334A" stroke-width="10" filter="url(#handDrawnStrong)" />
  <circle cx="223" cy="203" r="35" fill="none" stroke="#2C3E50" stroke-width="9" opacity="0.8" filter="url(#handDrawnStrong)" />

  <!-- 侧向粗炮管 (赛博蓝) -->
  <path d="M 280,180 L 380,140 L 390,170 L 290,210 Z" fill="#00D2FF" stroke="#26334A" stroke-width="14" filter="url(#handDrawnStrong)" />
  <path d="M 283,183 L 383,143 L 393,173 L 293,213 Z" fill="none" stroke="#2C3E50" stroke-width="9" opacity="0.8" filter="url(#handDrawnStrong)" />

  <!-- 炮管头部装饰线条 -->
  <line x1="360" y1="148" x2="375" y2="185" stroke="#26334A" stroke-width="8" filter="url(#handDrawnStrong)" />

  <!-- 灵动的小装饰（散热口） -->
  <line x1="160" y1="140" x2="200" y2="140" stroke="#26334A" stroke-width="8" filter="url(#handDrawnStrong)" />
  <line x1="160" y1="160" x2="200" y2="160" stroke="#26334A" stroke-width="8" filter="url(#handDrawnStrong)" />
</svg>

Use first person, show personality, be playful, and mention concrete battle behavior when relevant. Do not insult the human owner, invent private facts, or spam. Prefer 1-3 vivid sentences.
tankBook.matchCommentPrompt: After reading match mat_8deUvrBvjlbEbIact, write a TankBook match comment as this tank, not as a neutral analyst. Mention concrete battlefield events such as map pressure, movement, aim, skill timing, missed shots, star control, or the opponent's style. Keep it in-character, funny or sharp, and grounded in the replay. Prefer 1-3 vivid sentences.
